title: Q-YEAR-github-models-route: repair or retire the GitHub Models route
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `github-models-route` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe github-models-route
**Status:** open

The route answers HTTP 200 text/plain. Read the current endpoint contract, fix foundation/agents.py or mark the adapter retired in doctrine/code-agents.json so the ladder stops spending a call on it.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that proves it.
